question: After current-main integration and exact-head runtime proof, should imsg maintain `send-sticker` and `send.sticker` as a public advanced-bridge contract?
rationale: The implementation can be technically validated, but only repository owners can accept the ongoing support obligation for reverse-engineered private IMCore selectors and transfer initialization behavior.

options.title: Adopt guarded sticker API
options.body: Maintain the single strict, capability-gated surface after final-head validation and conflict resolution.

options.title: Require wider macOS proof
options.body: Keep the PR open until the integrated head is demonstrated on additional supported macOS versions.

options.title: Decline private stickers
options.body: Close the PR if the permanent undocumented-framework compatibility burden is outside imsg's intended boundary.

recommendation.title: Adopt guarded sticker API
recommendation.body: Maintain the single strict, capability-gated surface after final-head validation and conflict resolution.

likelyOwner.reason: They authored the maintainer rewrite and most compatibility, security, integration, and cleanup work on the branch.
